points.description: Initialisation: weights arranged in the required topology (lattice) and initialised randomly so that all weights are different.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.25) if only random initialisation or only topology is stated, not both.

points.description: Sampling and similarity matching: sample an input vector from the input space and match it to a neuron in the lattice (best match), which becomes the winning neuron.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.25) if sampling is stated but the winning neuron selection by similarity matching is missing, or vice versa.

points.description: Update: weights of the winning neuron AND its neighbours (determined by the neighbourhood function) are updated.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.25) if only the winner's weights are updated, or neighbours are mentioned without the neighbourhood function.

points.description: Shrinking and termination: neighbourhood is reduced and learning rate decayed; loop repeats from sampling until ordering and convergence are complete, then stop.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.25) if only the decay/shrinking or only the stopping/loop condition is stated.

rubric.notes: Steps must be explicit, correct and in order: initialise, sample, similarity match, update winner and neighbours, decay, loop until convergence. Vague wording (e.g. 'train the map') earns nothing; an error inside a step (e.g. updating only the losers, or no neighbourhood) cancels that step. Half marks only where clearly more than half of a point is stated precisely.
